vocabulary.meaning_en: the sand next to the sea
vocabulary.example: There's a beach in my town.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where adults study for a degree
vocabulary.note_ar: تبدأ بصوت yu لذلك نقول a university
vocabulary.note_en: It starts with a "yu" sound, so we say "a university".
vocabulary.example: There's a big university in Oxford.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long line of water that moves to the sea
vocabulary.example: There's a river in the city centre.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you watch films
vocabulary.example: Is there a cinema near here?
The train station is very busy.
There's an old cathedral in my town.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a big place where people watch football
vocabulary.example: The football stadium is near the river.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you buy things
vocabulary.example: There are lots of shops here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you buy and eat meals
a place where you borrow books
vocabulary.note_ar: جمعها libraries؛ ومحل بيع الكتب = bookshop
vocabulary.note_en: Plural: libraries. A shop that sells books is a bookshop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building where you can see old or interesting things
vocabulary.example: There are lots of museums in London.
There are some schools near my house.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you do exercise
vocabulary.example: There's a gym in my street.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building where you watch plays
a place where planes land and take off
vocabulary.example: Is there an airport? - Yes, there is.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a number of, not many and not few
the town where you were born or grew up
vocabulary.example: My home town is small and quiet.

fine_lines.title: there is / there are
fine_lines.explanation_ar: there is (there's) مع المفرد: There's a beach. و there are مع الجمع: There are shops.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use "there is" with one thing and "there are" with two or more things.

fine_lines.title: a / an
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم an قبل كلمة تبدأ بصوت متحرك (an airport)، و a قبل صوت ساكن (a beach). university تبدأ بصوت «يو» لذلك a university.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use "an" before a vowel sound (an airport) and "a" before a consonant sound (a beach, a university).

fine_lines.title: some / lots of
fine_lines.explanation_ar: some تعني عددًا معتدلًا، و lots of تعني عددًا كبيرًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Some" means a number of things; "lots of" means many.

expressions.meaning_en: ask about places in someone's town
expressions.example: What is in your town? - There's a beach and a river.
There's a beach and a university.
There are shops, restaurants and museums.
There are some gyms and theatres too.
Is there an airport in your town?
Is there a cinema? - Yes, there is.
Is there a train station? - No, there isn't.

grammar.title: There is / There are
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم there is للمفرد و there are للجمع لنقول إن شيئًا موجود. الاختصار: there's. لا نختصر there are في الكتابة عادةً.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "there is" (there's) for one thing and "there are" for plural things to say something exists.
examples: There are some schools, gyms and theatres too.

grammar.title: Questions and short answers: Is there ...?
grammar.explanation_ar: للسؤال نقدّم is أو are: Is there an airport? / Are there any parks? والجواب القصير: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. / Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
grammar.explanation_en: To ask, put "is/are" first. Short answers: Yes, there is. No, there isn't.
examples: Is there an airport? - Yes, there is.
Is there a beach? - No, there isn't.
Are there any museums? - Yes, there are.

questions.question: There ___ a river in my town.
Is there ___ airport?
questions.explanation_ar: airport تبدأ بصوت متحرك، لذا an.
questions.explanation_en: "Airport" starts with a vowel sound, so "an".

questions.question: Is there a cinema? - No, ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الجواب القصير المنفي: No, there isn't.
questions.explanation_en: The short negative answer is "No, there isn't."

questions.question: Where do you borrow books?
questions.explanation_en: You borrow books from a library.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: مع الجمع (three museums) نستخدم There are.

questions.question: What is a "cathedral"?
questions.explanation_en: A cathedral is a large, important church.

questions.question: The plural of "library" is ...
questions.explanation_ar: y بعد حرف ساكن تصبح ies.
questions.explanation_en: After a consonant, y changes to -ies.

questions.question: Which one is for watching films?
questions.explanation_en: You watch films at a cinema.

questions.question: Choose: "There's ___ university in Oxford."
questions.explanation_ar: university تبدأ بصوت «يو» الساكن، لذا a.
